paragraphs: An appointment-booking web application designed for VSB Engineering College campus visits, admission inquiries, and hostel visits. Visitors can book visits, track approval status in real-time, and download/print verified digital entry passes.
features: Public Visit Booking: A comprehensive booking form capturing visitor info, preferred date/time slot, course, and purpose of visit.
Faculty Approval Routing: Requests are assigned to relevant department faculty for approval, rescheduling, or rejection.
Real-Time Status Tracking: Visitors enter their booking reference ID to view request status (Pending, Approved, Rejected, Rescheduled) dynamically.
Digital Entry Pass: Once approved, the tracking page displays a secure QR Pass containing visit details and campus instructions.
Offline Entry Verification: Security gates or the admission office can scan the QR code (containing the signed validation token) to verify the visitor.
